name: NewTab - Edge
description: A Windows 11 / Edge-styled new tab page: 8 theme presets with custom accent color, auto light/dark by time or by system preference, wallpapers and gradients, geometric background patterns, multi-engine search (Baidu/Bing/Google/GitHub/威科/Bilibili) with live suggestions, search history, an inline results preview drawer, and a tools panel (calculator, base converter, color picker, JSON formatter, etc).
